parameters.name: ConnectionProperties
parameters.description: The connection configuration of the compute resource, including the endpoint, access identity, and environment context. The EnvType field is a member property of this object and specifies the environment of the compute resource. Valid values: DEV (development environment) and PROD (production environment). The EnvType value is case-insensitive.

parameters.name: ConnectionPropertiesMode
parameters.description: The category for adding the compute resource. Different types have different subtypes with different parameter constraints. For example, a Hologres compute resource supports InstanceMode (instance mode) and UrlMode (connection string mode).

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the compute resource. The description can be up to 3,000 characters in length.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the compute resource. The name can contain letters, digits, and underscores (_), and cannot start with a digit or underscore. The name can be up to 255 characters in length.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: The type of the compute resource. Multiple compute resource types are supported.
